links.comparator_used: Same models with provider-native reasoning disabled (non-reasoning configuration), in a 2x2 design crossed with same-source RAG
links.outcome: Overall SOAP note quality (seven automatic metrics and two reference-aware LLM judges) across OMI Health, ACI-Bench and PriMock57
links.effect: Enabling reasoning significantly degraded GPT-5.4 performance across all three datasets; the non-reasoning GPT-5.4 configuration achieved the highest overall quality under both evaluation approaches. No numeric effect sizes given in the abstract.
links.quote: Enabling reasoning significantly degrades GPT-5.4 performance across all three datasets, whereas same-source RAG yields smaller, model-dependent improvements.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (same-source RAG) and reasoning mode toggle
